title: This 294-Million-Year-Old Fossil Preserved Something Scientists Almost Never Find
description: It’s a big year for the do-it-all butthole known as the cloaca: the all-purpose pee, poop, and reproductive chute found in birds, reptiles, amphibians, and even a few mammals. Earlier this year, researchers identified what appears to be the first fossilized imprint of a reptilian cloaca. title: Unesco adds ancient Japanese capitals Asuka, Fujiwara to World Heritage list
description: Unesco decided on Sunday to add a group of ancient sites in Nara prefecture that show the formation of Japan’s centralised state to the World Heritage list, marking the country’s 27th such site. The decision on the Asuka-Fujiwara: Archaeological sites of Japan’s Ancient Capitals and Related Properties was made during a meeting of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation World Heritage Committee held in Busan, South Korea.
